comments.fonts: Source Serif 4 is not currently distributed via fontsource because it is variable-only and large. If used in the book, install via @fontsource/source-serif-4 or vendor the woff2 directly. Marketing site uses Inter (UI) and JetBrains Mono (code) only.
comments.katex: katex package is needed for the CSS file (katex/dist/katex.min.css). The remark-math + rehype-katex chain handles rendering at build time.
comments.node: Astro 6 dropped Node 18 and Node 20 support. Node 22 LTS is required.
comments.tooling: Pinned to Astro ^6.1 — confirmed compatible with Starlight 0.38+ in the book project. Do not downgrade.
